label: legend_0018_head_teacher_02
text: Please do try to keep your voice down if you’re\nmaking calls within the school, won’t you?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: legend_0018_head_teacher_03
text: You don’t want anyone else overhearing any\npersonal information, after all.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: legend_0018_head_teacher_04
text: Honestly... There are so many things we need to\nbe careful about in this day and age.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
